已关闭「主动刷新额度」：只重读本机已有的数据: "Active quota refresh" is off: only data already on this machine is re-read
只有以账号 / 订阅登录的工具才有额度；用 API Key、第三方供应商或本地路: Only tools signed in with an account / subscription have a quota; tools using an API key, a third-party provider or a local route (including Nomi chat) are billed by usage, so only usage and cost are tracked. Quota comes only from data already on this computer and from what the official CLI fetches itself when you click Refresh; the login method is read only from the official login status.
隐私：Nomi 不读取、不保存、不上传任何登录凭据（不打开 auth.json、: Privacy: Nomi never reads, stores or uploads any login credentials (it does not open auth.json, .credentials.json or the system keychain), calls no unpublished API and never estimates. When you click Refresh and the snapshot is out of date, the official CLI (claude -p /usage, codex app-server) is started briefly and fetches the quota with its own login; Nomi keeps only the percentage, window, reset time and plan. Note that Codex sends one request to OpenAI for this. There is no automatic polling, and each tool is refreshed at most once per 60 seconds; you can turn off "Active quota refresh" under "Privacy & data".
